subject: Request: SIG/SOC2 encryption artifacts — transport & KMS rotation
messages:
From: Elena Soto <security@nimbusfinancial.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SIG + SOC2 encryption artifacts — transport & KMS rotation

Hi Sean,

We're working through the SIG questionnaire and finalizing our SOC 2 internal review. A couple of items are blocking our compliance pack for Redwood:

- Can you provide the most recent rotation-test artifacts for KMS keys used to encrypt customer data (evidence that rotation occurred, operator logs, and the post-rotation integrity checks)? We need at least one end-to-end observed rotation (key -> wrap -> re-encrypt) sample.
- For in-transit encryption, please include TLS configuration summaries (cipher suites, minimum TLS version enforced, and any TLS termination points) and a short statement about mutual TLS where applicable.
- We also need an HSM attestation (vendor-signed) for the HSM you use for production key wrapping and an explanation of who has operator access during the key ceremony.

Deadline: May 31, if possible. Transfer via secure SFTP or provide a temporary signed link. If there are any redactions required, call them out and provide an explanation of the redaction so our auditors can accept the exhibits.

Thanks — attaching the SIG sections we are focused on (3.7 transport encryption, 6.2 key lifecycle) in-line for reference.

Best,
Elena Soto
Security Operations
Nimbus Financial

--
Requested items: rotation log (CSV), rotation witness screenshot, HSM attestation (PEM/PDF), TLS config summary
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <security@nimbusfinancial.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG + SOC2 encryption artifacts — transport & KMS rotation

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We'll assemble a compliance bundle and deliver via SFTP. Outline of plan below:

1) Today: confirm scope and internal owners (this email)
2) Tomorrow: run a dedicated rotation witness (non-production key material isolated to the tenant test harness), capture operator logs and KV cache snapshots, produce the rotation-log.csv and a short narrative describing redactions
3) Within 48h: export TLS configuration (tls-config.txt) and include a summary sentence for SIG/CAIQ mapping
4) HSM attestation: we will provide the vendor-signed artifact (hsm-attestation.pem) and a short access matrix describing operator roles.

Irene will run the rotation witness and prepare the sanitized logs. Marissa — looping you in to confirm the delivery channel and to coordinate a brief attestation signature if Nimbus needs a witness statement from Redwood legal or CS.

Target delivery: 2028-05-30 EOD Pacific. If you need anything sooner (e.g., a short attestation sentence), tell us which auditor contact we should send it to.

Hi Elena / Sean,

I've completed the rotation witness run on the tenant test harness this morning. Deliverables attached and notes below.

Attachments included in SFTP path: rotation-test-plan.pdf (plan + checklist), rotation-log.csv (sanitized operator logs), hsm-attestation.pem (vendor-signed blob), tls-config.txt (TLS termination map + cipher list)

Sanitization notes:
- rotation-log.csv: I removed user-identifying session tokens and replaced operator account emails with role labels (operator_1, operator_2). We include a redaction manifest column in the CSV describing each redaction.
- hsm-attestation.pem: vendor-signed, includes cert chain. If you require PDF letters, we can request a vendor letter but expect up to 3 business days.
- tls-config.txt: shows frontend (ALB) TLS policy: TLS1.2+ minimum, ciphers: ECDHE-ECDSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256; internal service-to-service uses mTLS with mutual cert rotation 

Key rotation summary (human-readable):
- Key alias: tenant/nimbus/k1 (test harness)
- Rotation start: 2028-05-26T07:00:02Z
- Wrap operation: performed via HSM (Thales Luna) key-encrypt-key (KEK) with vendor-wrapped key material
- Post-rotation verification: checksum match across s3 object metadata and KV cache snapshot; reference id: rot-witness-20280526-01

SFTP: sftp://sftp.redwood.com/nimbus/evidence/2028-05-30 (credentials will be sent out-of-band via our secrets channel). Files under evidence/2028-05-30 are time-limited (read-only, 7-day window).

If Nimbus requires a signed attestation from Redwood legal confirming the redaction rationale, Marissa can coordinate. Otherwise this bundle should map directly to SIG question 3.7 and CAIQ 10.3.

Hi Irene — thanks for the fast turnaround and for the detailed note. A few follow-ups: 

- The rotation-log.csv and redaction manifest look good from a data sensitivity perspective. Our auditors will want a short signed statement that the redactions were done by the vendor/account owner and do not affect the integrity of the evidence. Could you produce a 1-2 sentence attestation on company letterhead?
- For the HSM attestation: PEM is fine, but if you can also provide a one-page summary (PDF) stating the HSM model, FIPS/SWIMM or FIPS 140-2/3 status and the operator role separation, that will close the flag.
- Please open a DocuSign link for the attestation so our compliance team can retain an auditable signature.

If you can get the attestation PDF + DocuSign prepared by EOD 2028-05-30, we should be able to close this item ahead of our SIG submission. We will pull the files from your SFTP path once the link is live.

Appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
Elena
Security Operations
Nimbus Financial
